title: Mirabel and the Sigil
author: Casper Kavanagh
blurb: Ada Ashgrove, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
